answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the quartz of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the vault of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the quill re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
